bitcoin_articles.headline: Galaxy Digital CEO Mike Novogratz Shares Outlook on Bitcoin Price
bitcoin_articles.summary: Galaxy Digital CEO Mike Novogratz expressed skepticism regarding Bitcoin's ability to reach $90,000 by the end of 2026, citing macroeconomic headwinds.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Coinbase Expands Bitcoin-Backed Loan Availability to All 50 U.S. States
bitcoin_articles.summary: Coinbase has expanded its Bitcoin-backed loan service, now allowing users in all 50 U.S. states to borrow up to $5 million against their BTC holdings.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Maxim Group Maintains Buy Rating for American Bitcoin Corp.
bitcoin_articles.summary: Maxim Group analyst Matthew Galinko has maintained a "Buy" rating and a $15 price target for American Bitcoin Corp. (ABTC).

bitcoin_articles.headline: Ionic Digital Inc. Sells 737 BTC to Fund Infrastructure Construction
bitcoin_articles.summary: Ionic Digital Inc. has sold 737 Bitcoin to provide capital for the ongoing construction of its data center infrastructure.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The Smarter Web Company Announces Bitcoin Purchase and Weekly Preferred Dividend
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Smarter Web Company has purchased 55 Bitcoin for £2.75 million as part of its ongoing treasury strategy and confirmed the upcoming weekly preferred dividend payment.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Swiss National Bank Reports Holdings in Bitcoin Mining and MicroStrategy Stocks
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Swiss National Bank has disclosed ownership of approximately $120 million in Bitcoin mining stocks and $110 million in MicroStrategy shares.
